description: This file defines the DefaultCachesConfig class, implementing the CachesConfig interface. It manages cache configuration settings specific to the gateway's caches, particularly handling public keys cache configuration from a given Config object.

classes.name: DefaultCachesConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing CachesConfig, representing cache configuration with focus on public keys.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance based on provided Config object.

methods.name: getPublicKeysConfig
methods.description: Returns the cache configuration for public keys.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Provides hash code based on publicKeysConfig.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the config object.
